title: The Next AI Wave Will Change Humanity Forever. These 4 Stocks Will Lead the Market.
creator: MarketBeat
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions (auto captions; guest Keith Kaplan, TradeSmith CEO)
summary: MarketBeat hosts TradeSmith CEO Keith Kaplan on the 'biointelligence' wave: AI turned on human biology, which he frames as the biggest dataset on Earth (8 billion people) and an industry that never runs out of customers — cancer, heart disease, dementia and aging becoming engineering problems. Kaplan details 4 of 12 names from a free TradeSmith report, grouped by 'jobs'. 1) Guardant Health (GH) — BUY (first-tracked): the 'reader' pick; its Shield blood test screens for colorectal cancer from a simple draw, revenue tripled last quarter, ACS guideline inclusion, UnitedHealthcare coverage giving 94M people access; $23B market cap, +65% YTD, earnings late October. 2) Eli Lilly (LLY) — BUY, reiteration of Whitney Tilson's Oct 7 BUY: guiding $85-87B revenue vs $65B last year, Orforglipron pill approved in April, retatrutide filing early 2027, 42 phase-3 programs. 3) Moderna (MRNA) — CONDITIONAL_BUY (first-tracked): personalized cancer vaccine passed phase 3 in August, full data due Oct 24; guest says wait until after end-of-October earnings; high conviction but highest risk of the four, 'size speculative'. 4) Illumina (ILMN) — BUY (first-tracked): the 'toolmaker/shovel' pick; Grail chapter closed, guidance raised, back in the S&P 500. Passing mentions only: Medtronic (closest public door to brain interfaces), Merck (cancer-vaccine trial partner), Tempus AI. Caption quality: auto-captions garble names ('Eli Liy', 'Mjouro', 'Madna', 'Merc', 'Aluminina ILM') and some dollar figures.
